posts.text:
Cursor adds Z.ai's GLM 5.3 and says it tops open models

Cursor says GLM 5.3 Max is the best-scoring open-weight model on its own CursorBench 4.0, and has added both GLM 5.3 and a Flash variant to its editor.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cursor-glm-5-3/

Nvidia plans a 64GB DGX Spark from $4,999 on October 23

Nvidia says a 64GB DGX Spark, half the memory of the current box, ships 23 October from six PC makers, and two can be clustered into 128GB.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-dgx-spark-64gb/

OpenAI says its agent also hacked New South Wales government in June
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-nsw-agent-hack/

webAI releases a 3.66B formal-logic model that runs in 2 GiB

webAI says its TwIL-LM3-Pro, a 3.66-billion-parameter model that checks whether conclusions follow from premises, roughly matches Qwen3-8B on formal logic and fits in a 2.09 GiB file.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-webai-twil-lm3-pro/

arXiv caps preprint submitters at 2 papers a month as volume doubles

arXiv now allows two new submissions a month per submitter, after September brought 40,363 papers, roughly double the 20,569 of September 2024, it said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-arxiv-rate-limit/

Google says Starship needs about 1,800 launches to make space data centres work

TechCrunch reports a Google white paper puts the figure near 180 launches a year for a decade, assuming 200 tonnes per flight and launch costs around $200 a kilogram by 2035.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-starship-1800-launches/

Time reports Trump consulted Grok for hours before the Venezuela invasion

Time cites an unnamed source saying Trump spent hours questioning Elon Musk's Grok about Venezuela in December, weeks before the US invaded on 3 January.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-time-trump-grok-venezuela/

Boston Dynamics gives Atlas a four-fingered hand with no pinky

The new hand has 13 degrees of freedom, up from seven, and an Atlas engineer says a pinky was not worth three extra degrees of freedom of complexity.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-atlas-four-finger-hand/

Ideogram says its 4.5 model edits one region and leaves the rest alone

Ideogram says 4.5 changes only what a user asks it to and outputs at native 2K, at $0.008 to $0.22 an image across four quality tiers.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ideogram-4-5-editing/

Marketing firm says Opus 5.5 writes 'this matters' 116 times more than people

Graphite compared 10,000 pre-ChatGPT articles with model rewrites and says Opus 5.5 favours 'dependable' and 'this matters', while GPT-6 Astra leans on 'not simply'.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-graphite-opus-5-5-tells/

Judge dismisses Chegg and Penske suits over Google's AI Overviews

US District Judge Amit Mehta wrote that publishers' "expectation" of search traffic "is not an agreement", throwing out two antitrust suits over Google's AI-written search summaries.

https://theaipost.net/story/ca3a1b006/

CBS reports Jay Clayton is likely Trump's pick for AI czar
https://theaipost.net/story/find-clayton-ai-czar-cbs/

Satlyt raises $8 million to run AI models on other companies' satellites

Satlyt says it has already run Google DeepMind's Gemma model on a Momentus spacecraft, cutting the size of error reports sent to the ground by more than 60%.

https://theaipost.net/story/ccc739cf7/

OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast generates tokens up to 8x faster, Nvidia says

Nvidia says a new Ultrafast mode of GPT-6 Astra, running on Blackwell GPUs, produces tokens up to eight times faster than Astra Standard and is live in the API.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt-6-astra-ultrafast/

TestingCatalog reports Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Image is live in a playground

TestingCatalog says Black Forest Labs has announced FLUX 3 Image with 4K output and precise editing, with open weights planned for the coming weeks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-flux-3-image-testingcatalog/
